objectiveText: Get three of your marks in a row (horizontally, vertically, or diagonally) to win!
vsComputerDesc: You play as X against the AI.
twoPlayersDesc: Take turns with a friend on the same device.
step2: Click any empty square to place your mark
step4: First to get 3 in a row wins!
resetText: Click "Reset Game" at any time to start over. Your score will be preserved until you exit to the menu.
